hook: Paul's first letter to the Corinthians.
intro: First Corinthians is Paul's letter to a gifted but troubled church in Corinth, a busy Greek port city.
Chapters one to six deal with divisions, pride and wrongdoing. Chapters seven to fourteen answer their questions: marriage, freedom, worship, and spiritual gifts.
Chapter thirteen is the famous chapter on love. Chapter fifteen explains the resurrection.
Paul wrote it about twenty-five years after Jesus' resurrection.
Listen for the heart of it all: the greatest of these is charity, which here means love.

card.parts: Ch. 1–6: divisions and problems | Ch. 7–14: questions answered; love | Ch. 15–16: the resurrection
